1	# GlobalStone — Global Commercial Real Estate Services
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	GlobalStone is the global leader in commercial real estate services and investments, providing integrated, data-led solutions across every dimension of real estate. With services, insights, and data that span every dimension of the industry, we create solutions for clients of every size, in every sector, and across every geography.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #003F2D (deep forest green — primary), #012A2D (dark teal — secondary), #E6E6E6 (light gray — neutral)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: Investors Signal Their 2026 Real Estate Priorities
    10	Subtitle: Explore how investor sentiment, sector priorities, and strategy changes are reshaping real estate in 2026.
    11	CTA: "Read the Report"
    12	
    13	## Featured Insights (Homepage)
    14	- **The Weekly Take Podcast** — Back in the Game: As Lenders Return, CRE Financing Options Expand
    15	- **Explore Healthcare** — Law Firm Benchmarking Survey Highlights 2026
    16	- **Business Mobility** — The Shifting Landscape of Headquarters Relocations: 2026 Update
    17	
    18	## Announcement Banner
    19	"Record Data Center Demand Drives Vacancy to New Lows"
    20	CTA: "Explore the Report"
    21	
    22	## About Statement
    23	We are the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services. With services, insights and data that span every dimension of the industry, we create solutions for clients of every size, in every sector and across every geography.
    24	CTA: "Learn More" → Services
    25	
    26	## What We Do (Tabbed Section)
    27	- **Insights & Research** — Our 500+ global researchers offer actionable intelligence and a multi-dimensional perspective that is unparalleled in the industry. CTA: "Explore Insights & Research"
    28	- **Services** — Let us help you: Invest in real estate · Plan, lease & occupy · Design & build · Manage properties & portfolios · Transform business outcomes. CTA: "Explore Services"
    29	- **Careers** — We don't just realize the potential in real estate. We help you realize your potential. CTA: "Explore Careers"
    30	
    31	## Our Take Newsletter
    32	Title: Our Take Newsletter
    33	Subtitle: Expert perspectives on what matters most in commercial real estate.
    34	CTA: "Subscribe"
    35	
    36	## Latest Insights
    37	- **Book | Intelligent Investment** — North America Data Center Trends H2 2025 — February 25, 2026
    38	- **Book | Intelligent Investment** — U.S. Real Estate Market Outlook 2026 — January 14, 2026
    39	- **Podcast | Intelligent Investment** — Back in the Game: As lenders return, CRE financing options expand — April 14, 2026
    40	
    41	## Our Commitment
    42	- **Our Story** — We bring the diverse knowledge of our people, clients, and partners to realize potential in every business and every person. CTA: "Read More"
    43	- **Corporate Responsibility** — We take great pride in our reputation for upholding the highest standards in the way we do business. CTA: "Read More"
    44	- **Sustainability** — Accelerating sustainability by decarbonizing our own operations and influencing the way buildings are built, sourced, managed, occupied and sold. CTA: "Read More"
    45	- **Our Values-Driven Culture** — We help our employees learn, grow and stay safe and well while also engaging in our communities. CTA: "Read More"
    46	
    47	## Service Categories
    48	- **Invest, Finance & Value** — As the global commercial real estate brokerage leader, GlobalStone is your strategic partner across the entire real estate investment lifecycle. CTA: "Explore Service"
    49	- **Plan, Lease & Occupy** — As the #1 advisory and transactions firm in the world, GlobalStone offers unique insight, experience, and solutions to serve the needs of occupiers and owners. CTA: "Explore Service"
    50	- **Design & Build** — GlobalStone examines every aspect of your business or investment strategy to plan, design, develop, and deliver real estate. CTA: "Explore Service"
    51	- **Manage Properties & Portfolios** — Comprehensive property and facilities management solutions that maximize asset value and operational efficiency. CTA: "Explore Service"
    52	- **Transform Business Outcomes** — Strategic consulting and technology-driven solutions that align real estate with broader enterprise goals. CTA: "Explore Service"
    53	- **Invest in Real Assets** — Direct investment management across diversified real asset strategies for institutional and private investors. CTA: "Explore Service"
    54	
    55	## Investment Capabilities
    56	- **Capital Markets** — Global expertise in investment sales, debt and structured finance, and recapitalization services across all property types and geographies.
    57	- **Valuation & Advisory Services** — Independent, defensible valuations and strategic advisory powered by the industry's largest team of credentialed professionals.
    58	- **Global Forecasting & Analytics** — Proprietary econometric models and market intelligence that inform investment timing, asset selection, and portfolio construction.
    59	- **Sustainability Solutions** — ESG strategy, green building certification, and decarbonization advisory to future-proof assets and meet regulatory requirements.
    60	- **Transform Business Outcomes** — Data-driven consulting that connects real estate decisions to enterprise performance metrics.
    61	- **Strategic Investment Consulting** — Portfolio strategy, fund structuring, and capital allocation advisory for institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.
    62	
    63	## Featured Topics
    64	- Intelligent Investment
    65	- Future Cities
    66	- Adaptive Spaces
    67	- Evolving Workforces
    68	
    69	## Planning and Leasing Capabilities
    70	- **Transaction Services** — Tenant and landlord representation for office, industrial, retail, and specialty property leasing across global markets.
    71	- **Site Selection & Location Strategy** — Data-driven analysis combining labor analytics, incentives evaluation, and market benchmarking to optimize location decisions.
    72	- **Workplace Solutions** — Workplace strategy, change management, and space programming that align physical environments with workforce needs.
    73	- **Experience Services** — Hospitality-inspired facility experiences that elevate employee engagement and workplace satisfaction.
    74	- **Lease Administration** — Technology-enabled lease abstraction, compliance tracking, and critical date management for complex portfolios.
    75	- **Portfolio Strategy** — Holistic occupancy planning, scenario modeling, and cost optimization across multi-market portfolios.
    76	
    77	## Design and Build Capabilities
    78	- **Project & Program Management** — End-to-end oversight of construction and renovation projects, from feasibility and design coordination through delivery and closeout.
    79	- **Supply Chain Sourcing** — Strategic procurement and vendor management that reduce costs, mitigate risk, and accelerate project timelines.
    80	
    81	## Partnership Highlight
    82	GlobalStone's Design & Build division partners with leading architecture, engineering, and construction firms worldwide to deliver turnkey solutions. Our integrated approach ensures seamless coordination from concept through occupancy, reducing timelines by an average of 18% and delivering cost savings of up to 12%.
    83	
    84	## Navigation Structure
    85	**Main Nav:** Services · Insights & Research · Properties · People & Offices · Careers · About Us
    86	
    87	**Services Mega Menu — By Need:** Invest, Finance & Value · Plan, Lease & Occupy · Design & Build · Manage Properties & Portfolios · Transform Business Outcomes
    88	
    89	**Services Mega Menu — By Property Type:** Office · Retail · Industrial · Multifamily · Hotels
    90	
    91	## Footer Navigation
    92	About GlobalStone · Careers · Corporate Responsibility · Investor Relations · Newsroom

1 --- 2 name: web-frameworks 3 description: Build modern full-stack web applications with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, RSC, PPR, SSR, SSG, ISR), Turborepo (monorepo management, task pipelines, remote caching, parallel execution), and RemixIcon (3100+ SVG icons in outlined/filled styles). Use when creating React applications, implementing server-side rendering, setting up monorepos with multiple packages, optimizing build performance and caching strategies, adding icon libraries, managing shared dependencies, or working with TypeScript full-stack projects. 4 license: MIT 5 version: 1.0.0 6 --- 7 8 # Web Frameworks Skill Group 9 10 Comprehensive guide for building modern full-stack web applications using Next.js, Turborepo, and RemixIcon. 11 12 ## Overview 13 14 This skill group combines three powerful tools for web development: 15 16 **Next.js** - React framework with SSR, SSG, RSC, and optimization features 17 **Turborepo** - High-performance monorepo build system for JavaScript/TypeScript 18 **RemixIcon** - Icon library with 3,100+ outlined and filled style icons 19 20 ## When to Use This Skill Group 21 22 - Building new full-stack web applications with modern React 23 - Setting up monorepos with multiple apps and shared packages 24 - Implementing server-side rendering and static generation 25 - Optimizing build performance with intelligent caching 26 - Creating consistent UI with professional iconography 27 - Managing workspace dependencies across multiple projects 28 - Deploying production-ready applications with proper optimization 29 30 ## Stack Selection Guide 31 32 ### Single Application: Next.js + RemixIcon 33 34 Use when building a standalone application: 35 - E-commerce sites 36 - Marketing websites 37 - SaaS applications 38 - Documentation sites 39 - Blogs and content platforms 40 41 **Setup:** 42 ```bash 43 npx create-next-app@latest my-app 44 cd my-app 45 npm install remixicon 46 ``` 47 48 ### Monorepo: Next.js + Turborepo + RemixIcon 49 50 Use when building multiple applications with shared code: 51 - Microfrontends 52 - Multi-tenant platforms 53 - Internal tools with shared component library 54 - Multiple apps (web, admin, mobile-web) sharing logic 55 - Design system with documentation site 56 57 **Setup:** 58 ```bash 59 npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo 60 # Then configure Next.js apps in apps/ directory 61 # Install remixicon in shared UI packages 62 ``` 63 64 ### Framework Features Comparison 65 66 | Feature | Next.js | Turborepo | RemixIcon | 67 |---------|---------|-----------|-----------| 68 | Primary Use | Web framework | Build system | UI icons | 69 | Best For | SSR/SSG apps | Monorepos | Consistent iconography | 70 | Performance | Built-in optimization | Caching & parallel tasks | Lightweight fonts/SVG | 71 | TypeScript | Full support | Full support | Type definitions available | 72 73 ## Quick Start 74 75 ### Next.js Application 76 77 ```bash 78 # Create new project 79 npx create-next-app@latest my-app 80 cd my-app 81 82 # Install RemixIcon 83 npm install remixicon 84 85 # Import in layout 86 # app/layout.tsx 87 import 'remixicon/fonts/remixicon.css' 88 89 # Start development 90 npm run dev 91 ``` 92 93 ### Turborepo Monorepo 94 95 ```bash 96 # Create monorepo 97 npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo 98 cd my-monorepo 99 100 # Structure: 101 # apps/web/ - Next.js application 102 # apps/docs/ - Documentation site 103 # packages/ui/ - Shared components with RemixIcon 104 # packages/config/ - Shared configs 105 # turbo.json - Pipeline configuration 106 107 # Run all apps 108 npm run dev 109 110 # Build all packages 111 npm run build 112 ``` 113 114 ### RemixIcon Integration 115 116 ```tsx 117 // Webfont (HTML/CSS) 118 119 120 121 // React component 122 import { RiHomeLine, RiSearchFill } from "@remixicon/react" 123 124 125 ``` 126 127 ## Reference Navigation 128 129 **Next.js References:** 130 - [App Router Architecture](./references/nextjs-app-router.md) - Routing, layouts, pages, parallel routes 131 - [Server Components](./references/nextjs-server-components.md) - RSC patterns, client vs server, streaming 132 - [Data Fetching](./references/nextjs-data-fetching.md) - fetch API, caching, revalidation, loading states 133 - [Optimization](./references/nextjs-optimization.md) - Images, fonts, scripts, bundle analysis, PPR 134 135 **Turborepo References:** 136 - [Setup & Configuration](./references/turborepo-setup.md) - Installation, workspace config, package structure 137 - [Task Pipelines](./references/turborepo-pipelines.md) - Dependencies, parallel execution, task ordering 138 - [Caching Strategies](./references/turborepo-caching.md) - Local cache, remote cache, cache invalidation 139 140 **RemixIcon References:** 141 - [Integration Guide](./references/remix-icon-integration.md) - Installation, usage, customization, accessibility 142 143 ## Common Patterns & Workflows 144 145 ### Pattern 1: Full-Stack Monorepo 146 147 ``` 148 my-monorepo/ 149 ├── apps/ 150 │ ├── web/ # Customer-facing Next.js app 151 │ ├── admin/ # Admin dashboard Next.js app 152 │ └── docs/ # Documentation site 153 ├── packages/ 154 │ ├── ui/ # Shared UI with RemixIcon 155 │ ├── api-client/ # API client library 156 │ ├── config/ # ESLint, TypeScript configs 157 │ └── types/ # Shared TypeScript types 158 └── turbo.json # Build pipeline 159 ``` 160 161 **turbo.json:** 162 ```json 163 { 164 "$schema": "https://turbo.build/schema.json", 165 "pipeline": { 166 "build": { 167 "dependsOn": ["^build"], 168 "outputs": [".next/**", "!.next/cache/**", "dist/**"] 169 }, 170 "dev": { 171 "cache": false, 172 "persistent": true 173 }, 174 "lint": {}, 175 "test": { 176 "dependsOn": ["build"] 177 } 178 } 179 } 180 ``` 181 182 ### Pattern 2: Shared Component Library 183 184 ```tsx 185 // packages/ui/src/button.tsx 186 import { RiLoader4Line } from "@remixicon/react" 187 188 export function Button({ children, loading, icon }) { 189 return ( 190 194 ) 195 } 196 197 // apps/web/app/page.tsx 198 import { Button } from "@repo/ui/button" 199 import { RiHomeLine } from "@remixicon/react" 200 201 export default function Page() { 202 return 203 } 204 ``` 205 206 ### Pattern 3: Optimized Data Fetching 207 208 ```tsx 209 // app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx 210 import { notFound } from 'next/navigation' 211 212 // Static generation at build time 213 export async function generateStaticParams() { 214 const posts = await getPosts() 215 return posts.map(post => ({ slug: post.slug })) 216 } 217 218 // Revalidate every hour 219 async function getPost(slug: string) { 220 const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${slug}`, { 221 next: { revalidate: 3600 } 222 }) 223 if (!res.ok) return null 224 return res.json() 225 } 226 227 export default async function Post({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) { 228 const post = await getPost(params.slug) 229 if (!post) notFound() 230 231 return
{post.content}
232 } 233 ``` 234 235 ### Pattern 4: Monorepo CI/CD Pipeline 236 237 ```yaml 238 # .github/workflows/ci.yml 239 name: CI 240 on: [push, pull_request] 241 242 jobs: 243 build: 244 runs-on: ubuntu-latest 245 steps: 246 - uses: actions/checkout@v4 247 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 248 with: 249 node-version: 18 250 - run: npm install 251 - run: npx turbo run build test lint 252 env: 253 TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }} 254 TURBO_TEAM: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TEAM }} 255 ``` 256 257 ## Utility Scripts 258 259 Python utilities in `scripts/` directory: 260 261 **nextjs-init.py** - Initialize Next.js project with best practices 262 **turborepo-migrate.py** - Convert existing monorepo to Turborepo 263 264 Usage examples: 265 ```bash 266 # Initialize new Next.js app with TypeScript and recommended setup 267 python scripts/nextjs-init.py --name my-app --typescript --app-router 268 269 # Migrate existing monorepo to Turborepo with dry-run 270 python scripts/turborepo-migrate.py --path ./my-monorepo --dry-run 271 272 # Run tests 273 cd scripts/tests 274 pytest 275 ``` 276 277 ## Best Practices 278 279 **Next.js:** 280 - Default to Server Components, use Client Components only when needed 281 - Implement proper loading and error states 282 - Use Image component for automatic optimization 283 - Set proper metadata for SEO 284 - Leverage caching strategies (force-cache, revalidate, no-store) 285 286 **Turborepo:** 287 - Structure monorepo with clear separation (apps/, packages/) 288 - Define task dependencies correctly (^build for topological) 289 - Configure outputs for proper caching 290 - Enable remote caching for team collaboration 291 - Use filters to run tasks on changed packages only 292 293 **RemixIcon:** 294 - Use line style for minimal interfaces, fill for emphasis 295 - Maintain 24x24 grid alignment for crisp rendering 296 - Provide aria-labels for accessibility 297 - Use currentColor for flexible theming 298 - Prefer webfonts for multiple icons, SVG for single icons 299 300 ## Resources 301 302 - Next.js: https://nextjs.org/docs/llms.txt 303 - Turborepo: https://turbo.build/repo/docs 304 - RemixIcon: https://remixicon.com 305 306 ## Implementation Checklist 307 308 Building with this stack: 309 310 - steps.message:
The GlobalStone corporate website is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

## Output Files (`/app/output/`)

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Homepage with all 9 sections |
| `services.html` | Services overview with 6-category grid |
| `services-invest-finance-value.html` | Investment services detail page |
| `services-plan-lease-occupy.html` | Planning & leasing detail page |
| `services-design-build.html` | Design & build detail page |
| `styles.css` | Shared design system (~1,330 lines) |

## Key Features Implemented

1. **Mega Menu Navigation** — Desktop hover dropdown organized by "By Need" and "By Property Type"; mobile accordion-style navigation with hamburger toggle
2. **What We Do Tabs** — Smooth vertical tab switching on homepage (Insights & Research / Services / Careers)
3. **Service Detail Pages** — Consistent capabilities grids with iconography, related services, and insights
4. **Carousel** — Auto-rotating testimonial carousel on the Invest/Finance/Value page with dot controls
5. **Fully Responsive** — Mobile-first breakpoints at 1024px and 768px; grids collapse to single column on mobile
6. **Design System** — Deep forest green (#003F2D) and dark teal (#012A2D) palette with gold accent (#C9A227), Inter typography, consistent spacing and shadows

## Pages & Sections

- **Homepage**: Hero, Featured Insights bar, Announcement banner, About statement, What We Do tabs, Newsletter CTA, Latest Insights cards, Our Commitment pillars, Footer
- **Services**: Hero, Intro statement, 6 service category cards
- **Invest/Finance/Value**: Hero, Intro, 6 capability cards, Partner carousel, Deal flow CTA, Testimonial, Featured topics, Property types, Related services, Related insights
- **Plan/Lease/Occupy**: Hero, Intro, 6 capability cards, What We Do tabs (Tenant/Landlord/Consulting), Related insights
- **Design & Build**: Hero, Intro, 2 capability cards, Partnership highlight with stats (18% timeline reduction, 12% cost savings)
